_why: Run 25: 468 utterances, and the commonest single state a resident woke into was an unanswered question from somebody standing beside it. Bram at the outcrop with Ezra's price question open is the canonical one.

recent_speech.text: You have brought the last three loads lighter than the ones before. I need copper for three commissions. Name your price.

open_question_to_me: Ezra Okonjo is standing with you and has asked what you want for the ore in your hands.
